units.source_text: 无论该怎样去面对K，我都打算等到第二天再说，这一天是星期六的晚上。

en.t: Whatever I was going to do about facing K, I intended to leave it until the next day; that day was a Saturday night.

units.source_text: 但是，就在那天晚上，K自杀了。

en.t: But that very night, K took his own life.

units.source_text: 至今我一想起那晚的光景，仍是毛骨悚然。

en.t: Even now, whenever I remember the scene that night, I still shudder.

units.source_text: 我平时睡觉总是枕头朝东，可只有那晚是偶然枕头朝西睡的觉，这或许是什么兆头吧。

en.t: I usually slept with my pillow toward the east, but only that night, by chance, I slept with it toward the west; perhaps that was some kind of omen.

units.source_text: 我感觉枕边寒风飕飕，突然醒来，睁眼一看，

en.t: Feeling a cold wind whistling by my pillow, I suddenly woke up, and when I opened my eyes,

units.source_text: K和我的屋子之间一向关得很紧的隔扇，同几天前那个晚上一样开着，

en.t: the sliding partition between K's room and mine, which was usually kept tightly closed, was open just as it had been the other night a few days before,

units.source_text: 然而K那黑乎乎的身影，并没有像那天那样站在门口。

en.t: but K's dark figure was not standing in the doorway as it had been that night.

units.source_text: 我仿佛得到某种暗示似的，在地铺上用胳膊肘撑起身子，

en.t: As if I had received some sort of warning, I propped myself up on my elbows from the bedding on the floor,

units.source_text: 凝神朝K的房间望去，昏暗的油灯还点着，被褥也铺着。

en.t: and stared intently into K's room; the dim oil lamp was still lit, and his bedding was spread out.

units.source_text: 但是被子好像掀起来堆在脚底下，K头朝那边趴在被褥上。

en.t: But the quilt seemed to have been thrown back and piled near his feet, and K was lying face down on the bedding with his head turned away.
I called out, "Hey," but there was no answer.

units.source_text: ‘喂，你怎么啦？’我又叫了一声，K还是一动不动地趴着。

en.t: "Hey, what's wrong?" I called again, but K still lay there without moving.

units.source_text: 我马上站起来，走到门槛旁，

en.t: I immediately got up and went over to the threshold,

units.source_text: 借着昏暗的油灯，看了看他的房间。

en.t: and by the light of the dim oil lamp, I looked around his room.
